jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.The PositionJoin our Experimental Science team and help shape the future of eye health innovation.Based in either Biberach (Riss) or Ingelheim am Rhein, this exciting opportunity offers you the chance to contribute as a Biomarker Leader within the Experimental Medicine Eye Health Innovation Unit. If you are eager to drive scientific innovation and make a meaningful impact on patients' lives, we look forward to receiving your application. Apply today and help us transform the future of eye health.This position can be filled in Ingelheim or Biberach.This position can be filled either as Principal Scientist or Senior Principal Scientist.This position has a hybrid setup with approximately 1 - 2 days per week on site.This position is part time eligible with 80 %.Tasks & responsibilities- In your new role, you will be accountable for the development and implementation of end-to-end translational biomarker strategies from the preclinical to clinical early and late phases of drug development programs.- You will lead as a matrix leader biomarker- related activities from quantifying drug response on molecular pathways and imaging biomarkers and drives efforts to link these to impact on disease trajectories, functional assessments and patient benefit in relevant disease populations.- Furthermore, you will assume accountability for research collaborations focused on benefiting multiple programs in line with the project and disease area strategies.- You will be an active member of preclinical and clinical drug development teams and provides scientific and strategic input into the overall drug and clinical development plans by delivering fit for purpose biomarker strategies that drive decisions making and inform preclinical and drug development plans- Finally, you will collaborate with internal and external experts in academia, industry, service providers and device manufacturers for the assessment of biomarkers including AI approaches in experimental medicine and natural history studies for the identification and evaluation of biomarkers of disease and novel clinical trial endpoints.Additional tasks for the Senior Principal role- You will provide subject matter expertise and strategic guidance to internal and external projects and stakeholders and provide strategic input for multi-project and portfolio initiatives and disease area strategies.- In addition, you will lead end to end initiatives for the identification, validation and implementation of translational biomarkers and novel clinical endpoints to enable early drug development decision making and address the need to enable filing of novel and differentiated MoAs in our core indications.Requirements- PhD and/or MD degree with long term experience in research, industry or clinical setting, including several years of demonstrated biomarker-related work experience in the context of drug development- Proven ability to lead cross-functional matrix teams, drive strategic decision-making, and effectively prioritize activities to achieve both project objectives and team deliverables.- Strong expertise in methodological, bioanalytical, and clinical assessments within translational and clinical development with a deep understanding of biomarker applications across the drug development lifecycle. Prior experience in Ophthalmology or specific disease relevant human pathophysiology understanding are strong asset- Demonstrated capability to generate, integrate, and interpret preclinical, clinical, and translational data to support proof of biology, mechanism of action, dose selection, and patient stratification strategies- Strategic and innovative mindset with the ability to see the broader picture, translate complex scientific challenges into actionable solutions, and drive scientific and operational excellence- Collaborative and proactive team player with strong networking skills, capable of building effective partnerships across a global organization while working independently and within multidisciplinary teams- Excellent presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with full professional proficiency in EnglishAdditional requirements for the Senior Principal role- Recognized internally and externally as a subject matter expert, with a proven track record of delivering significant impact and innovation within the field- Well-connected within a strong international network of external experts, fostering strategic collaborations and knowledge exchange- Demonstrated experience in influencing and contributing to large-scale research initiatives, consortia, or cross-organizational programs- Strong leadership capabilities, with the ability to inspire teams, drive strategic priorities, and achieve ambitious objectivesAs part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.What we offerWith us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.comReady to contact us?If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com

Tätigkeitsbereich: IT/TelekommunikationFachabteilung: Payment-related ProductsGesellschaft: Mercedes pay GmbHStandort: BerlinStartdatum: 01.06.2026Veröffentlichungsdatum: 01.06.2026Stellennummer: MER00044HAArbeitszeit: Full timeAufgabenWHAT WE DOPicture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.ABOUT MERCEDES PAYMercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about!OUR VALUES & HOW WE WORKWe are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than sulking at inconveniences.Since we are still building new processes alongside new products, new joiners have the opportunity to make as much impact as our most seasoned veterans. We really love a lively exchange of ideas, whether a teammate’s been with us for two days or ten years. And, frankly, fresh energy is always welcome. YOUR DAY AT GLANCEYou assess current systems, infrastructure, and business processes to identify improvement opportunities and ensure compatibility with new solutions- You collect and analyze stakeholder requirements to define solution scope and objectives- You architect the Mercedes Pay Digital Voucher Solution, detailing structure, components, interfaces, and data flows, and select suitable technologies, platforms, and tools- You create proof-of-concept projects to validate solutions and demonstrate feasibility- You work with an experienced team of Solution Architects as well as the company's Enterprise, Cloud and Security Architects to derive right-fit solutions- You facilitate the collaboration with external development teams, ensuring adherence to architectural guidelines and best practices- You communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex technical details into accessible language- You document solutions and disseminate best practices among team membersQualifikationenWHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE- You hold a degree in Computer Science or a related field- You have 5+ years of experience as a Solution Architect, with a strong focus on software product development- You have practical experience in at least one of the following domains: regulatory environments, agentic commerce, loyalty programs, vouchers, digital marketing, or payments (including PCI DSS, PSD2/SCA, or AML/KYC)- You are proficient in microservices, event-driven architectures, cloud-native technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, CI/CD), Auth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) protocols, alongside practices like Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and DevOps- You have hands-on experience with tools such as Jira, GitHub, and Datadog- You have a proven track record of implementing cutting-edge technologies within a corporate environment- You possess strong teamwork and good communication skills, with the ability to maintain composure under pressure- You are fluent in English; German language skills are a strong plusOUR OFFER TO YOU·       Modern and dynamic work environment·       Flexible and mobile working·       Attractive fitness offer·       Numerous employee discounts·       Excellent infrastructureThis is a full-time job (also suitable for part-time). We particularly welcome applications from disabled persons. Please apply online via www.group.mercedes-benz.com/careers (ID:MER0003ZHV). For questions, please don’t hesitate to contact the HR Team of Mercedes pay GmbH: career_mercedespay@mercedes-benz.comBenefits- Barriere­frei­heit- Coaching- Betriebs­arzt- Mit­arbeiter Events- Mit­arbeiter­rabatte möglich- Mit­arbeiter­beteili­gung möglich- Mit­arbeiter­handy möglich- Essens­zulagen- Gesund­heits­maß­nahmen- Hybrides Arbeiten möglich- Lebens­langes Lernen- Betrieb­liche Alters­ver­sorgung- Park­platz- Gute An­bindung- Flexible Arbeits­zeit möglichKontaktNatali KosEmail: natali.kos@mercedes-benz.comOtto-Braun-Strasse 7810249 Berlin
